note: KOA Holiday about 11 km west of Drumheller on North Dinosaur Trail, on the Red Deer River in the badlands. RV sites range from treed grass water/electric sites to gravel and concrete 50-amp full hookups; also tent sites and cabins, a seasonal pool, mini golf and a dog park. The 15-amp electric-only sites are for units under 18 ft. --Claude
